column5: Stuck in Waiting | Stuck in Fear | Stuck in Comparison | Stuck in Burnout | Stuck in Disobedience

column5: Joseph in Prison | David Anointed but Not Yet King | Abraham Waiting for Isaac | Moses in Midian | Hannah Praying for a Child | Sarah Past Hope

column4: how do I know God's will
column5: The Counsel-Seeker | The Peace-Waiter | The Open-Door Walker | The Scripture-First | The Bold Mover

column1: What's Your God-Given Calling Style?

column8: 'Compare and despair' + 'feel like I'm falling behind while everyone has their life together' is documented across 20s/30s mental-health and Christian content

column6: Names the specific flavor of the 20s/30s unraveling with a faith lens; quarter-life crisis is a highly shareable, self-deprecating hook

column1: Open Door or Closed Door?

column1: Why Do You Feel Purposeless Right Now?

column6: Goes straight at the raw 'I feel purposeless' search with compassionate, specific causes; high emotional resonance
column8: 'Many Christians question their true purpose and seek it in ways that lead to confusion and anxiety' (purpose video) + purposeless feelings in quarter-life threads

column1: Which Door Is God Asking You to Walk Through?

column8: Calling-coaching content ('7 steps to confirm your calling') + 'analysis paralysis keeps you from your divine calling'
